MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The outdoor VELCRO tape felt relevant because my recent drywall anchors suggest mounting tasks, and it could help attach something light if the surface and load are suitable.",
    "That recommendation connected with the purpose of my recent purchases: securing things in place, with attention to where and how they will be attached."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Locking nuts are fastening supplies, but they require bolts; my recent purchases involve wood screws, framing nails, and drywall anchors, so they do not meet the same immediate need.",
    "Heat shrink tubing, magnets, a thermometer, and a pulley each serve specific tasks that my recent activity gives me no reason to pursue.",
    "Duct tape has some repair relevance, but eighteen rolls exceed my current needs. The six-pack of lubricant also feels excessive, especially without an immediate lubrication task.",
    "Pegboard baskets would help with storage, but buying fastening supplies does not mean I am currently organizing a workshop."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions seem to treat general repair and workshop usefulness as enough reason for me to choose an item now.",
    "They seem to assume that buying packs of nails and screws means I also want large quantities of unrelated maintenance supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The repeated nails, wood screws, and anchors point toward specific fastening and mounting needs; the material, dimensions, and compatible tools matter to whether another item is useful.",
    "I need a clear current use for an item. Being potentially useful someday is not enough to make me choose it.",
    "Quantity matters for the particular task: needing many fasteners does not imply needing eighteen rolls of tape or six cans of lubricant."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized a repair and mounting interest but stretched it into unrelated workshop supplies without enough attention to my immediate task or required quantity."
}
